===History in Counter-Strike (2019)===
Aspas initially competed in ''Counter-Strike: Global Offensive'' under [[counterstrike:g3nerationX|g3nerationX]] under the name of ''aspa$''. After leaving the team aspas however created a smurf account under the nickname of akari. This account according to reports was banned on the Brazilian platform ''Gamers Club'' on August 20th, 2019 for eight years for violating the Terms of Use. <ref name="Gamers Club Ban">{{cite web|url=https://www.dust2.com.br/noticias/30973/campeao-mundial-de-valorant-aspas-jogou-pela-g3x-e-esta-banido-na-gc|title=Campeão mundial de Valorant, aspas jogou pela g3x e está banido na GC|trans_title=Valorant world champion, quotes played for g3x and is banned on GC|date=2022-08-18|author=vhporto|publisher=Dust2.br|language={{Flag|ptbr}} Portuguese}}</ref>

===Entry into VALORANT (2021)===
Aspas started appearing in the Brazilian VALORANT scene playing with a free agent team known as the [[favela aimmers]], which was shortly acquired by [[SLICK]]. <ref name="SLICK pickup">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/slickgg_/status/1373650644473630722|title=Que surpresa|trans_title=What a surprise|author=[[SLICK]]|language={{Flag|ptbr}} Portuguese|date=2021-03-21}}</ref> Together with [[SLICK]] he competed in the [[VALORANT_Champions_Tour/2021/Brazil/Stage_2/Challengers_1/Open_Qualifier|Qualifier]] to make it to the [[VALORANT_Champions_Tour/2021/Brazil/Stage_2/Challengers_1|Challengers]] stage in Brazil.

Aspas and the team were released following the conclusion of the third stage. <ref name="SLICK drop">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/slickgg_/status/1431270316630847495|title=Seja bem vindo, DISBAND!|trans_title=Welcome, DISBAND!|author=[[SLICK]]|language={{Flag|ptbr}} Portuguese|date=2021-08-27}}</ref>

===Joining LOUD and Winning Champions (2022)===
Heading into 2022 Aspas had joined a new team consisting of Bryan "[[pANcada]]" Luna, Gustavo "[[Sacy]]" Rossi, Matias "[[Saadhak]]" Delipetro, Felipe "[[Less]]" Basso, and himself that played under "Pancada e Amigos". Making it through the Open and Closed qualifier to qualify for the new year's stage one, they were signed by [[LOUD]]. <ref name="LOUD val">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/LOUDgg/status/1489358159949017091|title=ALÔ VALORANT, TA ME CUTANO?|trans_title=HELLO VALORANT, ARE YOU BORING ME?!|author=[[LOUD]]|language={{Flag|ptbr}} Portuguese|date=2022-02-03}}</ref>

===Another Year with LOUD & Transitioning to Leviatán (2023)===
Following their run at [[VCT/2023/Champions|Champions]], aspas announced that his contract with LOUD had expired and that he was a free agent. <ref name="LOUD leave">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/aspaszin/status/1701249784126816639|title=I came here to give you some news: my contract with LOUD has ended and with that I am a free agent and open to hearing proposals. “I can speak English and Portuguese”|author='''aspas'''|language={{Flag|usuk}} English|date=2023-09-11}}</ref> Within a month aspas had found a new home for the following competitive year, as he signed with [[Leviatán]]. <ref name="Aspas Leviatan">{{cite web|url=https://x.com/LeviatanGG/status/1712243348952502521|title=Finalmente el tornado llegó a Buenos Aires|trans_title=The tornado finally reached Buenos Aires|author=[[Leviatán]]|language={{Flag|esmx}} Spanish|date=2023-10-11}}</ref>

2022)=== benjyfishy originally made a name for himself in [[:Fortnite:benjyfishy|Fortnite]] in 2019, when he signed with [[NRG Esports]] aged 15 and double-qualified to the ''Fortnite World Cup'' in both [https://liquipedia.net/fortnite/Fortnite_World_Cup/2019/Finals/Solo Solos] and [https://liquipedia.net/fortnite/Fortnite_World_Cup/2019/Finals/Duos Duos], placing 25th and 14th respectively. {{cite web|url=https://www.oneesports.gg/valorant/benjyfishy-fortnite-to-valorant-esports/|title=From Fortnite to Valorant: The biggest name at Masters Madrid isn’t TenZ, it’s him|author='''Nigel Zalamea'''|publisher=ONE Esports|date=2024-03-14}} {{Quote |quote= "I’m a very competitive person and Fortnite isn’t a competitive game, I wanted to do something I enjoyed more and I’d have more motivation for, which is why I made the switch."|sign=Benjy "benjyfishy" Fish|source=}} benjyfishy's entrance into ''VALORANT'' was a quiet one, having entered the scene in 2022, two years after the game's release, benjyfishy wanted to earn his place in the scene, playing the game as much as possible and taking the time to improve his understanding of the game, throughout 2022 benjyfishy was streaming for [[NRG]] while competing in {{Abbr|VRC|Valorant Regional Circuit}} Benelux - Trinity Trials with follow ex-Fortnite player Jack "[[Nakirye]]" Li. The team performed well, finishing the [[Trinity_Trials/2022/Fall_Trial|Fall Trial]] top 2, qualifying their team to [[VRL/France_Revolution/Coupe_De_France/2022|Coupe De France 2022]], proving to benjyfishy that he had what it takes to compete in ''VALORANT''. ===Moving Upwards, Challengers & Team Heretics (2022 - Present)=== In December 2022, benjyfishy announced he had signed with [[Enterprise Esports]] as a stand-in, marking his entry into Tier 2, joining [[Surge|Challengers East - Surge]] alongside ex-Fortnite player Patrik "[[Minny]]" Hušek. During this time, benjyfishy was confident in his own skill, and seeing how quickly he had advanced to Challengers, he did not sign a contract with Enterprise, competing as a stand-in with the team. {{cite web|url=https://youtu.be/pAu2RePxNJk|title="My Goal is to be the GOAT" - benjyfishy Interview|author='''[[Tombizz]]'''|date=2023-08-02}} With Enterprise, benjyfishy was able to comfortably slot into the team, winning their first event [[Grunex_Challenge/2|Grunex Challenge #2]] in December 2022, before beginning their journey in Challengers in January. Throughout Challengers East [[VCL/2023/East/Split_1|Split 1]], benjyfishy put up a strong individual performance, completing the split in second place after falling to [[Acend]] 3-0 in the Grand Final. benjyfishy's performance throughout the split earned him the Rookie of the Season award. {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/valleague_east/status/1639301454073675785|title=benjyfishy is our Rookie of the Split!|author='''[[Surge|VALORANT Challengers East: Surge]]'''|date=2023-03-24}}. [[VCL/2023/East/Split_2|Split 2]] was no different for the team, with benjyfishy and Enterprise performing well, advancing all the way to the Grand Finals once again, however again falling short at the last hurdle, suffering another 3-0 loss in the Grand Finals to [[Acend]]. Back-to-back second places were enough for Benjy and the team to earn enough [[VCL/2023/East/Circuit_Points|circuit points]] to qualify for the [[VCL/2023/Ascension/EMEA/Play-In|Ascension Play-In]], however, fate seemed to have different plans for benjyfishy. In May 2023, [[Team Heretics]] had to find an emergency replacement for their VCT International League roster, following the departure of Aleksander "[[zeek]]" Zygmunt. [[Riot Games]] however, set a stipulation that Heretics would only be able to sign a player who was classified as a "Free-Agent", co-incidentally, 6 months earlier benjyfishy did not sign a contract, enabling him to trial, and eventually sign with [[Team Heretics]] despite competing in Challengers with [[Enterprise Esports]]. {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/Lembo006/status/1662146160256073751|title=LEAK: Riot ha permitido a Heretics fichar un jugador para sustituir a Zeek en VCT EMEA|language={{Flag|es}} Spanish|trans_title=LEAK: Riot has allowed Heretics to sign a player to replace Zeek in #VCTEMEA|author='''[[Lembo]]'''|date=2023-05-26}}}} [[Masters Madrid 2024|Masters Madrid]] was a whole new ballpark for the rookie [[Team Heretics]] roster however, and the team faltered slightly from their Kickoff performance, falling 0-2 to an impressive [[Sentinels]] in round 1, and getting eliminated by [[Paper Rex]] following a 1-2 loss in round 2. Despite these two close losses, benjyfishy's attitude about the event and the team was only positive, looking forward to beginning the regular season with their full roster as [[Wo0t]] reaches the minimum age to compete {{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/benjyfishy/status/1769473123395797383|title=see u soon|date=2024-03-17|author='''benjyfishy'''}} {{Quote | quote="It was an unreal experience playing in this arena with all of the incredible fans, thank you for making it so special." |sign=Benjy "benjyfishy" Fish |source=}} ==Gallery== Heretics benjyfishy at Valorant Champions 2025 Playoffs.jpg|benjyfishy at [[VCT/2025/Champions|VALORANT 2025 Champions]] with [[Team Heretics]] Enterprise Esports benjyfishy.png|benjyfishy with [[Enterprise Esports]] in 2023 benjyfishy at Red Bull Home Ground 4 - EMEA Qualifier.jpg|benjyfishy at [[Red_Bull/Home_Ground/4/EMEA_Qualifier|Red Bull Home Ground #4: EMEA Qualifier]] with [[Team Heretics]] Heretics benjyfishy at VCT 2024 EMEA Kickoff.jpg ==References== {{Reflist}}
